description: Finalists eligible for locked-TEST evaluation from the Local-Sum decisive validation round.
note: Local-Sum observable QNN PASSED its 20-seed paired promotion gate as a QUANTUM ARCHITECTURE improvement over the existing global-observable default (statistical_tests.json: mean Delta PR-AUC +0.0536, bootstrap 95% CI [+0.0149,+0.0913] excludes zero, Wilcoxon p=0.0086, not outlier-driven). However, it is NOT registered as a finalist for locked-TEST evaluation, because the locked-test gate's condition 3 (a quantum-inclusive ensemble must beat its matched non-quantum comparator) failed: XGBoost+Local-Sum-QNN (PR-AUC 0.9665) did not beat XGBoost+classical-capacity-control (PR-AUC 0.9671) -- delta -0.0007, 95% CI [-0.0072,+0.0057], crosses zero. Per the pre-specified locked-test gate rule, ALL of conditions 1-6 must pass before the locked TEST split may be touched; condition 3 alone failing is sufficient to keep it closed. The locked TEST split (research/experimental_protocol/locked_split.json) was not read by any script in this round.
